title: The Flopper Mod
description: Inspired by the Flopper block from Minecraft 2.0, this mod adds dispenser-like blocks that, when activated with redstone, will convert and shoot out any and all things put into it into fish!
body:
Inspired by the Flopper block from Minecraft 2.0, this mod adds dispenser-like blocks that, when activated with redstone, will convert and shoot out any and all things put into it into fish! 

This mod adds two Flopper variants. First there's the regular Flopper, which will output 1 fish per item/block. And then there's the much more expensive _Big Flopper_, which can output an infinite amount of fish, alongside one for each block/item placed into it, for a total of two fish per redstone pulse.

![Floppers flopping fish and flopper/big flopper crafting recipes (dispenser recipe with fish instead of bow and flopper surrounded by diamond blocks respectively)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ZLHThX4r/images/2f225f218f12686e0b7bda7390af114e0aa22f54.png)
